summary: Frontend-only end-to-end testing of RCC Leads Closer flow on https://lead-caller-pro.preview.emergentagent.com. Setup leveraged direct API calls (POST /api/users + POST /api/leads with assigned_closer_id) for reliability after discovering the lead form payload field name. AuthContext logout->login race fix from iteration 2 is HOLDING for admin->closer and closer->filler role switches when localStorage+cookies are cleared between sessions; closer dashboard now reachable end-to-end. Verified closer dashboard, both lead cards, status pills, filters, StatusUpdateDialog Approved flow including 'Notes are required' validation, and Follow-up validation 'Pick a follow-up date'. Two issues remain: (1) closer-logout sometimes does not navigate to /login (state cleared but URL still /closer) — flaky, (2) filter-follow_today returns all leads instead of follow-up-today only — looks like backend filter is not honoring the follow_up_today query param.

minor.issue: Returned all assigned leads (2) even when none had follow_up_date=today. Either the param is ignored or the closer scope branch skips the filter.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking [data-testid=closer-logout] the in-memory user state is cleared but the URL sometimes remains /closer instead of redirecting to /login. Reproduced on 2nd run; first run worked. Likely missing a useNavigate('/login') after logout() OR ProtectedRoute not re-evaluating fast enough.

react-day-picker day buttons use button[name="day"], NOT [role="gridcell"] button. Manual click works, but selecting a day in automation does not always propagate to the dialog's date state — after picking a day & saving, lead remained 'Not Called' on one run. Likely the popover closes on selection before React state commits, OR the disabled predicate (d) => d < new Date(new Date().setHours(0,0,0,0)) excludes today silently in some TZs. Worth verifying the onSelect handler updates state synchronously and that today is selectable.

action_items: FIX (HIGH): StatusUpdateDialog calendar — confirm onSelect updates date state before popover closes, and that today is selectable. Consider using onSelect={(d) => { setDate(d); }} with controlled Popover (open state) so the Save still has the date in scope. Add data-testid to individual day buttons to make automation deterministic if possible.
FIX (MED): CloserDashboard logout — call useNavigate('/login', {replace:true}) after logout() to guarantee URL navigation; relying solely on ProtectedRoute re-render is intermittently failing.
FIX (MED): Backend GET /api/leads?follow_up_today=true for closer role — ensure the date filter is applied; currently returning all assigned leads. Validate via curl as closer.
(Minor A11y) Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to StatusUpdateDialog & New User dialog to silence Radix warnings.
(Doc) Standardise lead assignment field name. UI form testid is 'lead-closer-select' per review_request but iteration 2 saw 'lead-assign-select'; backend wants 'assigned_closer_id'.
critical_code_review_comments: CloserDashboard polls /api/leads every 5s — fine, but combine with backend follow_up_today filter bug, list will keep over-reporting if user filters and walks away.

StatusUpdateDialog Popover is uncontrolled — selecting a date inside a Dialog inside a Popover can race when both close on outside click. Make the Popover controlled and only close it after onSelect commits.
AuthContext.logout() does not redirect; it relies on each role page or ProtectedRoute to detect user=false. A single explicit navigate('/login') after clearing state would be more robust.

tel: link is implemented as window.location.href on a button (not <a href="tel:">). Per review_request the spec says 'clickable phone (tel: link)'. Consider rendering an <a href="tel:..."> for proper mobile UX and so screen readers/right-click work.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend URL = https://lead-caller-pro.preview.emergentagent.com (from frontend/.env). For role-switch flows you MUST clear cookies AND localStorage between sessions (await page.context.clear_cookies(); page.evaluate(()=>localStorage.clear())) — the logout button only clears token+user, not the cookie reliably across rapid switches. Backend POST /api/leads expects field 'assigned_closer_id' (NOT 'closer_id'). Calendar in StatusUpdateDialog uses button[name="day"], NOT [role="gridcell"] button. Auto-accept window.confirm via page.on('dialog', ...). The Call button uses window.location.href='tel:...' which won't navigate in headless Chromium — do not assert navigation, just assert the visible phone number on the button.
rca of the issue: 1) Calendar bug RCA: react-day-picker day buttons render as <button name="day"> inside <td>, not inside [role=gridcell] button. Click works in DOM but the parent Popover may close on click before the controlled date setter executes inside the Dialog (Radix focus trap interplay). Mitigation: control Popover open state and explicitly close it inside onSelect after setDate. 2) Logout not navigating RCA: AuthContext.logout sets user=false synchronously and clears token, but does not call navigate(). ProtectedRoute re-render usually catches it but sometimes the route component unmounts before navigation triggers, leaving the URL stale. Mitigation: call navigate('/login', {replace:true}) immediately after logout() in CloserDashboard's logout handler (and in admin/filler too for safety). 3) follow_up_today RCA: backend likely accepts the param only for admin scope; for closer role it short-circuits the filter and returns all assigned leads. Mitigation: apply follow_up_today filter regardless of role in the leads service.
